$comment: Pending-reference registry for scripts/spec-drefs (#326). An entry declares a D-number cited in a scanned surface that has NO `| D<n> |` row in docs/SPEC.md §5 today, with the reason and the trigger that removes it. It exists so a required check can be green on main while the register itself declares a decision ratified-but-pending — the debt stays visible instead of being silently permitted. An entry nothing references is reported as W-ALLOWLIST-UNUSED (not a failure). Empty is the steady state: a new entry needs a row already tracked by an issue.
